title_sq: Tek Liqeni i Thatë Shitet Apartament Luksoz Me Pamje Nga Liqeni
description_sq: Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e trete te nje pallati te ri me ashensor ne kompleksin FZ. Mobilimi eshte bere me Arkitekt dhe eshte i paperdorur fare nga qe pronaret jetojne jashte. Ne hyrje eshte tualeti i dites me hidrosanitare moderne dhe dush Ariston, me pas eshte salloni me dalje ne ballkon dhe pamje nga liqeni si dhe kuzhina e veçuar me elektroshtepiake cilesore. Ne te majte eshte dhoma e femijeve me dalje ne ballkon dhe dhoma e çiftit me tualetin e vete. Pallati eshte nga me te miret ne zone dhe mund te blihet parkim me çmim ekstra. Kontakto menjehere ne numrin e telefonit per me shume informacion.
title_en: Luxury Apartment For Sale At Dry Lake With Lake View
description_en: The apartment is located on the third floor of a new building with an elevator in the FZ complex. The furniture was made by an architect and is completely unused since the owners live outside. At the entrance is the day toilet with modern hydrosanitary and Ariston shower, then there is the living room with access to the balcony and a view of the lake, as well as the separate kitchen with quality appliances. On the left is the children's room with access to the balcony and the couple's room with its own toilet. The palace is one of the best in the area and parking can be purchased at an extra price. Contact immediately on the phone number for more information.
